description: Mdexa is a database of biomedical datasets that agents call over MCP or, with an API key, an HTTP API. Use this first: keywords (q) and filters, every condition in one call. COMPLETENESS: 'Complete: these are ALL N datasets ...' means you hold the full answer: do not repeat the search with other words or filters. FILTERS: several values of ONE parameter are ORed; different parameters are ANDed; a parent domain includes its sub-domains. The tag facets task_format, intended_use, specialty, condition_scope, population, source_type, annotation_depth, expert_involvement, size_tier, data_format, official_split, benchmark_status (specialty = department, condition_scope = ICD-11 chapter); their values come from list_facets (only=<facet>), and a wrong value is answered with the allowed ones. Known slugs: slugs=a,b needs no keyword. q: Chinese or English or another language; typos, synonyms and meaning are matched. Each row has answer (license status, commercial_use, derivatives, redistribution, key quote with URL and date), risk_flags, repo_only (true = only a code repository license), card_url, last_verified: enough for license questions. Models: code and weights licenses apart. Registered entries: no conclusion. restricted, conflict, unstated and unverifiable never mean commercial use is allowed. Output fits max_tokens (default 1500); next_cursor gives more. no_match (did_you_mean) means the Mdexa database does not list it: do not retry with other words. related rows are nearby records, NOT matches.

explain.description: Add match.fields / match.via to each row.

hints.description: off: no return note and the visit is not recorded (the same as the header X-Mdexa-Hints: off). on or absent: default.

include_derived.description: false = only stated or inferred tags.

license_status.description: permissive = commercial use and redistribution allowed; unreviewed = registered, no conclusion.

max_tokens.description: Response size cap in estimated tokens; rows are dropped from the end.

q.description: Keywords or a short description, any language.

slugs.description: Exact slugs (OR); unknown ones come back in unknown_slugs.

tag_source.description: declared = only tags the authors state or a reviewer confirmed.

tier.description: verified and practical: license concluded with evidence; registered: listed, NOT verified. Default all, verified first.

name: search_datasets
title: Search datasets
